sets.title: Managed as code (YAML)
sets.empty: No settings are managed as YAML yet.
sets.emptyHint: Getting started: 1. Get the current settings as files with Export as YAML in a page's ⋯ menu (VMs, networks, …) or orbivisorctl export 2. Keep the files in Git 3. orbivisorctl apply --set name -f folder.
sets.aboutWhat: Write settings such as VMs, networks and rules as YAML files, and make the cluster match them in one go.
sets.aboutWhen: To review and record settings in Git, or to keep several clusters the same. Not needed if you only use the UI.
sets.aboutStart: Take the current settings with Export as YAML in a page's ⋯ menu or orbivisorctl export, edit them, then apply with the command below. Resources made with Terraform are not listed here; they are managed separately (label orbivisor.io/managed-by=terraform — compare with terraform plan).

set.lastError: The last apply did not finish: {{error}}
set.driftHint_one: {{count}} resource differs from the files (someone changed it in the UI, CLI or API). Choose one:
set.driftHint_other: {{count}} resources differ from the files (someone changed them in the UI, CLI or API). Choose one:
set.adoptAll: Keep all current values as the file values
set.adoptChosen_one: Keep {{count}} chosen current value as the file value
set.adoptChosen_other: Keep {{count}} chosen current values as the file values
set.adopted: {{name}} now remembers the current values as its file values.
set.adoptTitle: {{name}}: keep the current values as the file values?
set.adoptHint: Nothing in the cluster changes. The 'file values' the set remembers become the current values. Then fix the files in Git with orbivisorctl export --set.
set.adoptItem: {{kind}} {{name}}: its current values become the file values
set.adoptMissing: {{kind}} {{name}}: gone from the cluster, so it leaves the set
set.revertWay: Put it back as in the files: apply the same files again.
set.adoptWay: Keep the current values as the file values: the cluster stays as it is and the set remembers the current values. Then update the files with orbivisorctl export --set {{name}}.
set.compareHint: Only the fields written in the files are compared, resource by resource. Fields that differ are highlighted.
set.masked: The value is masked, so what differs is not shown (the server only reports that it differs).
set.uncheckedHint: The server has not compared this set with its files yet (right after an apply or a leader change — the next check will).
set.webHint: Yellow fields are this page's own comparison, for reference (not the server's) — the server compares after filling defaults and list order, so it may differ.
set.unmanagedHint: The set's label was removed from this resource, so the set no longer manages it.
set.tooMany: Many resources: only the first {{count}} are compared here. See the rest with orbivisorctl drift.
set.appliesHint: Tasks that applied this set (those still in the task log). Open a row for details.
set.noApplies: No applies left in the task log.
